create.name: Marie Diamond
create.bio:
Marie Diamond is a feng shui master and law of attraction teacher, widely known as one of the teachers in the 2006 film The Secret. She says she was a clairvoyant child who spoke with angels from about the age of five, and that a near-death experience in her teens set the direction of her life. Over some thirty years she has built her own system, Diamond Feng Shui, which treats a home as a three-dimensional vision board, alongside Diamond Dowsing, space clearing and a colour-based practice she calls Inner Diamond Meditation. Her home-study course Diamond Feng Shui first appeared in 2005, and she has since fronted a television series, Feng Shui Your Life.

Today she teaches mainly through online programmes on her own site: introductory and advanced feng shui, a year-long certification for those who want to practise professionally, manifestation courses on abundance and love, and guided meditation programmes working with angels and archangels. She also gives home and office consultations, mentors individuals and businesses, speaks at conferences, hosts a podcast and runs occasional in-person courses and retreats in Europe and the United States. Her YouTube channel holds many free talks and meditations. She lives in Bel Air, Los Angeles, with her husband.

courses.title: Diamond Feng Shui Certification
courses.description: Her professional training for those who want to work as Diamond Feng Shui consultants, mixing self-paced video lessons with live monthly question sessions. The current intake runs from November 2026 to September 2027.

courses.title: Feng Shui Your Life
courses.description: A beginners' online course in her approach to feng shui, with four video lessons on arranging the home to support success, relationships and wisdom.

courses.title: Feng Shui Period 9
courses.description: An advanced feng shui programme on the twenty-year cycle that began in February 2024, for people buying, moving into or renovating a home.

courses.title: Feng Shui Space Clearing
courses.description: An online programme on clearing a home both physically and energetically, so there is room for new things to come in.

courses.title: Your Home Is A Vision Board Workshop
courses.description: A recorded workshop on using feng shui to turn the rooms of a home into a vision board for the life you want.

courses.title: Abundance Magic
courses.description: A beginner-friendly manifestation programme with goal-setting methods, energetic tools and meditations for attracting abundance.

courses.title: Inner Diamond Meditation
courses.description: Eight online sessions in her meditation method, which works with 24 colours she calls the Diamond Quantum Colors.

courses.title: Inner Diamond Meditation Advanced Program
courses.description: The next stage after the basic course, taking the colour meditations further and linking them to manifestation practice.

courses.title: Angel Magic Program
courses.description: A beginners' meditation course on connecting with guardian angels and other angelic helpers, drawing on her own experience of them since childhood.

courses.title: Archangel Magic Program
courses.description: A follow-on meditation course working with the archangels, their signs and their protection.

free_resources.title: Law of Attraction Meditation: The Tubes of Light
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation on her YouTube channel, about eleven minutes long, using her Tubes of Light visualisation.
